std: sample standard deviation, ddof=1; never pooled across time
paired_difference: gated minus stock for matching noise/fault seed

recovery.censor: first physical contact, truncated flight or end of matched clean trace; report recovered count and conditional mean/std

clear_spike_improvement: For each of the four during/post-5s RMS endpoints, negative mean paired difference and at least 4/5 seeds strictly improved; descriptive consistency, not a population significance claim. Full-run maxima reported separately.
truncation: Report observed maxima with duration. An incomplete window is not treated as a complete RMS window; comparable pair count is explicit. A partial maximum is a lower bound: exceeding a completed counterpart proves worse, but a smaller partial maximum never proves better.

rate_directions.fault_active_rejection: higher detection rate; not by itself flight benefit
rate_directions.forced_count: frequency diagnostic; increases listed separately from performance deterioration
